Testimonials

## Stories That Take Flight

Allen Hancock

New Bern, USA

“I became very active in the PA-32 Owner’s and Pilots Facebook Group and eventually spearheaded a
group fly-in which became the largest gathering of its type in history. We had the full support of
Piper Aircraft, as well as many other major aviation brands and fulfilled my personal goal to have
accomplished something truly meaningful in aviation.”

Chris Hibben

Oshkosh, USA

“I use the M600 to support our airshow business, Chambliss Aerobatics. The M600 is used to transport
team members and spare parts for our airshow airplane. Its range, payload and versatility make it
the perfect plane for my business. The M600’s speed and handling qualities make it a sheer joy to
fly, and that makes it the perfect airplane for me.”

Shadi Wadi-Ramahi

Evansville, USA

“During winters, my wife and I flew with our twins to the Bahamas and all around Florida. We have
made many other memorable weekend trips to places like Niagara Falls, Nashville and Myrtle Beach… I
have stuck with Piper all these years because of the performance, safety, and value. I have trusted
the reliability of Piper in flying my family to numerous destinations over the last 25 years and
look forward to continuing to do so.”

# Piper is Proud to Introduce the M700 Fury

[Explore the M700 Fury][106]

Business. Adventure. The Better Life.

## A Piper Aircraft for **All Scenarios**

When Mr. Piper introduced the Piper Cub in 1937, he had a dream – the freedom of flight for
everyone. Over 130,000 aircraft later, generations have lived that dream. Training in Pipers.
Serious business transportation in Pipers. Pipers bring a higher level of safety, technology and
performance to enhance the lives of owners. Piper is the Freedom of Flight.

Testimonials

## Stories That Take Flight

Allen Hancock

New Bern, USA

“I became very active in the PA-32 Owner’s and Pilots Facebook Group and eventually spearheaded a
group fly-in which became the largest gathering of its type in history. We had the full support of
Piper Aircraft, as well as many other major aviation brands and fulfilled my personal goal to have
accomplished something truly meaningful in aviation.”

Chris Hibben

Oshkosh, USA

“I use the M600 to support our airshow business, Chambliss Aerobatics. The M600 is used to transport
team members and spare parts for our airshow airplane. Its range, payload and versatility make it
the perfect plane for my business. The M600’s speed and handling qualities make it a sheer joy to
fly, and that makes it the perfect airplane for me.”

Shadi Wadi-Ramahi

Evansville, USA

“During winters, my wife and I flew with our twins to the Bahamas and all around Florida. We have
made many other memorable weekend trips to places like Niagara Falls, Nashville and Myrtle Beach… I
have stuck with Piper all these years because of the performance, safety, and value. I have trusted
the reliability of Piper in flying my family to numerous destinations over the last 25 years and
look forward to continuing to do so.”

## Smart for businesses, smart for partners

With new features like easy onboarding and built-in fraud prevention, we’ve reimagined Authorize.net
to help you get paid fast. See what’s new for businesses and partners.

[For businesses][34]

[For partners][35]

## See how we’ve reimagined Authorize.net

### New features, built for speed

Get paid faster with customizable dashboards, smart AI support, and built-in fraud prevention—all
powered by Visa’s payments ecosystem.

### Take, request, and find payments

Get set up fast with a seamless, intuitive payment experience.

### Not sure about something? Ask Anet

Get the answers you need, fast, with our new AI support tool, Ask Anet.

### Workspaces that stay connected

Stay connected across tools, teams, and transactions—backed by Visa.

### Tools to stop fraud fast

Protect every payment with built-in, real-time fraud detection.

[Demo for businesses][36]

[Demo for partners][37]

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

[ [Learn more about Simple Checkout] ][41]

# Find Cheap Flights, Deals, News & Travel

[Up]

Find cheap flights easily on Avianity.com

Just enter your flight route and dates. We’ll show you tickets from different airlines and agencies.
Book directly on their sites without any extra fees.

## [Wizz Air Accuses Serbia of Trying to Force Closure of Its Belgrade Base][7]

[June 5, 2026][8] [avianity][9] [Airline News][10]

Wizz Air has accused Serbian authorities of introducing aviation rules that could force the airline
to close its base at Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport. The Hungarian low-cost carrier says the proposed
regulations would significantly limit its ability to operate flights from Serbia and could require
the relocation of aircraft currently based in Belgrade.

[Read more][11]

## [Thailand Bans the Use of Power Banks During Flights][12]

[June 5, 2026][13] [avianity][14] [Airline News][15]

The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has introduced new rules governing the transport and
use of portable battery packs, commonly known as power banks, on board aircraft. The restrictions
apply to all passengers departing on flights from Thailand and are intended to enhance aviation
safety.

[Read more][16]

## [Ryanair to Close Berlin Base and Cut Flights by Half][17]

[June 5, 2026][18] [avianity][19] [Airline News][20]

Irish low-cost carrier Ryanair has announced it will close its base at Berlin Brandenburg Airport.
Beginning October 24, 2026, the airline will remove seven aircraft based in the German capital and
significantly reduce its flight schedule.

[Read more][21]

## [Qantas Unveils First Ultra-Long-Range Airbus A350 for Nonstop Flights][22]

[April 14, 2026][23] [avianity][24] [Airline News][25]

Qantas has taken delivery of its first Airbus A350-1000ULR, designed to operate ultra-long-haul
flights lasting more than 20 hours.

[Read more][26]

## [Southwest to Allow Free Checked Wine on Select Flights][27]

[April 14, 2026][28] [avianity][29] [Airline News][30]

U.S. airline Southwest Airlines will introduce a program allowing passengers to check wine for free
on select domestic flights.

[Read more][31]

## [Lufthansa warns of flight disruptions during pilot strike on March 12–13][32]

[March 12, 2026][33] [avianity][34] [Airline News][35]

German airline Lufthansa is preparing for schedule disruptions after pilots announced a two-day
strike set for March 12–13, 2026. The walkout, organized by the Vereinigung Cockpit union,
is expected to lead to flight cancellations and timetable changes across the airline’s network.

[Read more][36]

## [Wizz Air receives approval to operate flights between the U.K. and the U.S.][37]

[March 10, 2026][38] [avianity][39] [Airline News][40]

The U.S. Department of Transportation has granted Wizz Air’s British subsidiary approval to operate
passenger flights between the United Kingdom and the United States. The authorization covers both
scheduled and charter services.

[Read more][41]

## [U.S. State Department Urges Americans to Depart Several Middle Eastern Countries
## Immediately][42]

[March 3, 2026][43] [avianity][44] [Airline News][45]

The U.S. Department of State has advised American citizens to leave a number of Middle Eastern
countries due to heightened security risks across the region.

[Read more][46]

## [Japan Plans to Ban Use of Power Banks on Flights][47]

[February 19, 2026][48] [avianity][49] [Airline News][50]

Japan is preparing new restrictions for air travelers that would prohibit the use of power banks
during flights starting in April.

[Read more][51]

## [Nepal May Tighten Mount Everest Climbing Rules][52]

[February 18, 2026][53] [avianity][54] [Airline News][55]

Nepal’s parliament is reviewing a bill that would introduce stricter requirements for climbers
seeking to summit Mount Everest.

[Read more][56]

## [Wizz Air Accuses Serbia of Trying to Force Closure of Its Belgrade Base][7]

[June 5, 2026][8] [avianity][9] [Airline News][10]

Wizz Air has accused Serbian authorities of introducing aviation rules that could force the airline
to close its base at Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport. The Hungarian low-cost carrier says the proposed
regulations would significantly limit its ability to operate flights from Serbia and could require
the relocation of aircraft currently based in Belgrade.

[Read more][11]

## [Thailand Bans the Use of Power Banks During Flights][12]

[June 5, 2026][13] [avianity][14] [Airline News][15]

The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has introduced new rules governing the transport and
use of portable battery packs, commonly known as power banks, on board aircraft. The restrictions
apply to all passengers departing on flights from Thailand and are intended to enhance aviation
safety.

[Read more][16]

## [Ryanair to Close Berlin Base and Cut Flights by Half][17]

[June 5, 2026][18] [avianity][19] [Airline News][20]

Irish low-cost carrier Ryanair has announced it will close its base at Berlin Brandenburg Airport.
Beginning October 24, 2026, the airline will remove seven aircraft based in the German capital and
significantly reduce its flight schedule.

[Read more][21]

## [Qantas Unveils First Ultra-Long-Range Airbus A350 for Nonstop Flights][22]

[April 14, 2026][23] [avianity][24] [Airline News][25]

Qantas has taken delivery of its first Airbus A350-1000ULR, designed to operate ultra-long-haul
flights lasting more than 20 hours.

[Read more][26]

## [Southwest to Allow Free Checked Wine on Select Flights][27]

[April 14, 2026][28] [avianity][29] [Airline News][30]

U.S. airline Southwest Airlines will introduce a program allowing passengers to check wine for free
on select domestic flights.

[Read more][31]

## [Lufthansa warns of flight disruptions during pilot strike on March 12–13][32]

[March 12, 2026][33] [avianity][34] [Airline News][35]

German airline Lufthansa is preparing for schedule disruptions after pilots announced a two-day
strike set for March 12–13, 2026. The walkout, organized by the Vereinigung Cockpit union,
is expected to lead to flight cancellations and timetable changes across the airline’s network.

[Read more][36]

## [Wizz Air receives approval to operate flights between the U.K. and the U.S.][37]

[March 10, 2026][38] [avianity][39] [Airline News][40]

The U.S. Department of Transportation has granted Wizz Air’s British subsidiary approval to operate
passenger flights between the United Kingdom and the United States. The authorization covers both
scheduled and charter services.

[Read more][41]

## [U.S. State Department Urges Americans to Depart Several Middle Eastern Countries
## Immediately][42]

[March 3, 2026][43] [avianity][44] [Airline News][45]

The U.S. Department of State has advised American citizens to leave a number of Middle Eastern
countries due to heightened security risks across the region.

[Read more][46]

## [Japan Plans to Ban Use of Power Banks on Flights][47]

[February 19, 2026][48] [avianity][49] [Airline News][50]

Japan is preparing new restrictions for air travelers that would prohibit the use of power banks
during flights starting in April.

[Read more][51]

## [Nepal May Tighten Mount Everest Climbing Rules][52]

[February 18, 2026][53] [avianity][54] [Airline News][55]

Nepal’s parliament is reviewing a bill that would introduce stricter requirements for climbers
seeking to summit Mount Everest.

[Read more][56]

Welcome to Aviation Strategy — the boutique Aviation Consultancy and Publisher of the
highly-respected [*Aviation Strategy*][11] Newsletter.

# Consulting

Our focus is on all aspects of commercial aviation. Our clients include LCCs, Regional, Charter and
Network airlines, private equity houses, government and regulatory bodies, airports, banks, leasing
companies and manufacturers. Based in London, our clients are global — in Europe, Asia, Africa, the
Middle East and Americas. When required, Aviation Strategy forms teams of established experts to
address particular issues. To find out more about Aviation Strategy please email
[info@aviationstrategy.aero][12].

## Services

The principals and associates of Aviation Strategy have extensive experience in analysing,
commenting, reporting and forecasting on all commercial aspects of the aviation industry.
* [Business Planning and Due Diligence ][13]
* [IPOs, Privatisation and State Aid ][14]
* [Operating & Financial Models][15]
* [Market Analyses ][16]
* [Governments ][17]
* [Expert Witness ][18]
* [Airport Forecasting ][19]
* [Slot Valuation & Trading][20]

## Partners — Skailark

Skailark is a new technology company set up to provide competitive data and analysis to the aviation
industry — informing decisions on strategy, transformation, M&A, fleet, and network.in the
post-pandemic world.

Skailark has built up contemporaneous data on the detailed costs and key drivers for 200-plus
airlines globally, information that can be accessed on a flight, segment, fleet, company or industry
basis.

Skailark’s web-based platforms allow for user-friendly dynamic modelling. See for example, the
analysis of the proposed Frontier Spirit merger in the [April 2022 issue of *Aviation
Strategy*][21].

To understand more about the service please contact Christian Soyk through
[contact@skailark.com][22] or visit [https://skailark.com/][23]

[ [Skailark logo] ][24]

## Partners — Global Aviation

Aviation Strategy has entered into a partnership with Athens-based [ Global Aviation SA ][25].
Global Aviation was founded in 1997 by Markos Tsaktanis, whose career includes top managerial and
Board of Directors’ positions at Aegean Airlines, Lease Corporation International (LCI) and Group 4,
among others. Markos is now Chairman of the company while his two sons, Petros and Alexandros, are
Managing Directors.

[ [Global Aviation SA logo] ][26]

## Newsletter

[[Issue ]][27]

The specialist newsletter Aviation Strategy is normally published at least six times a year. Our
editorial policy is to analyse contemporary aviation issues and airline strategies in a clear,
original and objective manner. Aviation Strategy does not shy away from critical analysis, and takes
a global perspective, with balanced coverage of the European, American and Asian markets.

The newsletter is available under a personal digital subscription (special offers are available for
multiple subscriptions, intra-net distribution and academic study) and is emailed on publication. A
subscription also provides online access to over 20 years of archives.

### Comments

Aviation Strategy is one of the very few aviation journals that carries in-depth analyses of
individual airlines or critical aviation issues. These are stimulating, well documented and clearly
argued. I always look forward to seeing and reading what’s in the next issue. Prof RD, London

Great publication, lots of good analysis GC, Seattle

I appreciate receiving this, in my opinion it is one of the best industry publications. SM, Seattle

[Watch Trailer][58][Learn Commands][59][Play for Free][60]

## Real-Time Strategy

## Redefined

### Every unit, projectile and explosion simulated in real-time

### Unmatched

### **Scale** & **realism**

All units and projectiles are simulated in real-time. The game offers fully simulated projectile
ballistics, explosion physics and terrain deformation.

Enjoy an immersive RTS experience, whether you are commanding individual units, or armies of
thousands. Take control as you engage in an epic struggle for domination!

[Screenshots][61][Gameplay][62]
[Big Cortex Base]
[Armada Artillery on high ground, shooting enemy units from afar.]

### Strategic

### **Importance of terrain**

The shape of every battlefield in-game imposes which strategies work and which units are effective.
**No two maps will play the same**. Radar cannot penetrate mountains and nuclear warfare will
physically alter the terrain.

Utilize over 10 different unit classes, including all-terrain Experimental units, to work your way
to victory.

[Learn how to Play][63]

### Countless

### **World-class controls**

**Your power lies in the careful balance of exponentially growing your resource income and the
production of devastating war machines.**

You decide if you want to disarm your enemies with a few precise early strikes or to build a
thousand bombers and obliterate them.

Immerse yourself in a violent world where tactical and strategical supremacy are needed in your
fight towards victory.

[Commands Overview][64]
[Complex user-interface filled with commands and orders for a large strategical attack.]
[Large attack force of Armada with T1-T2-T3 units, ready for battle.]

### Relentless game design

### **Unique and with a purpose**

Each and every unit in the game has a role to fill. Mix-and-match units to create **infinite
possible tactics**. Experiment with your own combinations and show off the new strategies you
develop in battle.

‍

# The** Epic scale** RTS experience you've been waiting for

[Watch Trailer][58][Learn Commands][59][Play for Free][60]

## Real-Time Strategy

## Redefined

### Every unit, projectile and explosion simulated in real-time

### Unmatched

### **Scale** & **realism**

All units and projectiles are simulated in real-time. The game offers fully simulated projectile
ballistics, explosion physics and terrain deformation.

Enjoy an immersive RTS experience, whether you are commanding individual units, or armies of
thousands. Take control as you engage in an epic struggle for domination!

[Screenshots][61][Gameplay][62]
[Big Cortex Base]
[Armada Artillery on high ground, shooting enemy units from afar.]

### Strategic

### **Importance of terrain**

The shape of every battlefield in-game imposes which strategies work and which units are effective.
**No two maps will play the same**. Radar cannot penetrate mountains and nuclear warfare will
physically alter the terrain.

Utilize over 10 different unit classes, including all-terrain Experimental units, to work your way
to victory.

[Learn how to Play][63]

### Countless

### **World-class controls**

**Your power lies in the careful balance of exponentially growing your resource income and the
production of devastating war machines.**

You decide if you want to disarm your enemies with a few precise early strikes or to build a
thousand bombers and obliterate them.

Immerse yourself in a violent world where tactical and strategical supremacy are needed in your
fight towards victory.

[Commands Overview][64]
[Complex user-interface filled with commands and orders for a large strategical attack.]
[Large attack force of Armada with T1-T2-T3 units, ready for battle.]

### Relentless game design

### **Unique and with a purpose**

Each and every unit in the game has a role to fill. Mix-and-match units to create **infinite
possible tactics**. Experiment with your own combinations and show off the new strategies you
develop in battle.

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

**About us**

Island Trails started out of a desire to do better. Do better for our planet and community, but also
to participate in something bigger. We hope to inspire and leave you with a sense of awe and
connection to our wild spaces. Through providing education on our rad Island adventures, or in the
classroom, entertaining young minds. With ideas of interconnectivity and care for the natural world,
there is something for all.

Imagine every step taking you deeper into the interconnected beauty of our Coastal Rainforest
Ecosystem. Moving from the impressive canopy of the old growth forest to the vibrant Pacific Ocean.
We’ll make sure nothing gets missed for you. Making the trip of a lifetime and leaving in awe of our
natural wonders!

**Land acknowledgment**

We want to acknowledge and honour the places we operate in, and it’s history before sharing them
with you. We are fortunate to be able to work, live and play on the traditional and unceeded
territory of the lək̓ʷəŋən speaking peoples. Today known as the Esquimalt and Songhees Nations,
Malahat, Pacheedaht, Scia’new, T’Sou-ke, W̱SÁNEĆ (Pauquachin, Tsartlip, Tsawout, Tseycum) peoples,
the K’ómoks First Nation, including Sathloot, Sasitla, leeksun, Puledge, Cha’chae, and Tat’poos
Peoples, Snuneymuxw, Snaw-naw-as, Quw’utsun, and Tla’amin First Nations. The first people have been
looking after their lands for centuries before colonization. Hopefully we can help them continue
this by supporting them and contribute to our common future in this special place we are fortunate
to call home.

## Discover Mauritius
## 
## from the sky with
## Island Wings

[ SEAPLANE TOURS ][15]
[ RUNWAY TOURS ][16]
WELCOME TO ISLAND WINGS

### Take flight,
### 
### 
### Create
### Memories

Step into a seaplane or microlight and discover the Mauritian coastlines from a higher perspective.

[PLAY VIDEO][17]
SIGHTSEEING TOURS

### Experience the rush of taking off from land or sea

Island Wings gives you the choice of taking off from the lagoon or runway, making your experience an
adventure of a lifetime!

# Seaplane Tours

Take off from our seabase in the turquoise lagoon in front of Lux* Grand Gaube Hotel, and experience
the breathtaking sceneries from above.
[ VIEW THE TOURS ][18]

## Runway Tours

Take off from our runway in Mon Loisir sugar estate and discover the beauty of the island and
lagoons of Mauritius from another perspective.
[ VIEW THE TOURS ][19]
DUO FLIGHTS

# Fly side by side together
# 
# in two seaplanes

Our seaplanes are two-seaters, one seat reserved for the pilot and one for the passenger. Share the
experience of flying together, side by side, in two separate seaplanes.

[ BOOK NOW ][20]
SEAPLANE TOURS

### Take your sightseeing activities to new heights

Discover our selection of Seaplane Tours ranging from 15 mins to 100 mins

15 mins
€160
per passenger
Ile D’ambre
Takeoff from our turquoise blue seabase in front of LUX* Grand Gaube Hotel, overflying both land and
sea of the North East coast.
[ LEARN MORE ][21]
30 mins
€235
per passenger
The Blue Hole
Takeoff from our turquoise blue seabase in front of LUX* Grand Gaube Hotel, overflying both land and
sea of the North East coast. Full of Turtles, rays and during the austral winter (June to
September), majestic humpback whales migrate from Antarctic feeding grounds to the warmer waters
around Mauritius.
[ LEARN MORE ][22]
60 mins
€365
per passenger
Île aux Cerfs
Takeoff from our turquoise blue seabase in front of LUX* Grand Gaube Hotel, overflying both land and
sea. This flight will allow you to discover some of the most beautiful lagoons of the island, from
our base you will fly down the east coast, past Roches Noires following the coast line down to îles
aux cerfs and back up towards our Sea Base.
[ LEARN MORE ][23]
80 mins
€435
per passenger
Île au Phare
This flight down to Grand Port, the oldest port of Mauritius will allow you to discover the biggest
lagoon of the east coast of the island flying past île au Phare, also known as Île aux Fouquets
where the lighthouse was built in 1864. Continuing down to Île aux Aigrettes and back to the base.
[ LEARN MORE ][24]
100 mins
€650
per passenger
Underwater Waterfall of Le Morne
This flight will allow you to discover some of the most beautiful lagoons of the island – you will
also see the 7 islands of the North-East coast, South coast all the way to the South West coast and
fly over the famous Underwater Waterfall of Le Morne and back up the East coast towards the North.
[ LEARN MORE ][25]
[ VIEW ALL FLIGHT PATHS ][26]
WHAT OUR CLIENTS SAY

### Hear it straight from our happy customers

[ GOOGLE REVIEWS ][27]
[ TRIP ADVISOR ][28]


“We had the most amazing experience with Island Wings and I would wholeheartedly recommend the
seaplane tour to other travellers. The views were incredible and it was worth every penny!”


"Well worth the money! What a thrilling flight. Words are inadequate to describe just how fabulous,
how blissful, how unforgettable, this experience was."


“This was definitely the highlight of our trip to Mauritius. A special thanks to Bruno, Amelie and
our pilots. We will not forget these moments.”

# Book a Seaplane
# Tour Now!

Are you ready to experience the beauty of Mauritius from above?

Join us on an unforgettable journey with our seaplane tours.

We can’t wait to welcome you aboard!
[ BOOK YOUR FLIGHT ][29]
ISLAND WINGS MAURITIUS
Thank you for visiting! We’re dedicated to giving you the best customer service, ensuring each tour
is both enjoyable and memorable. Get ready to explore Mauritius with us!

## The Technology *Stack*

↻

### Geothermal Grid

Phased geothermal generation from Padang, delivered through HVDC infrastructure. Zero diesel
dependency by design.

450-550 MWGEOTHERMAL TARGET
POWER ARCHITECTURE

Siberut rests on the Australian tectonic plate - geologically stable, not volcanic. Mainland
geothermal generation is planned as a phased 450-550MW portfolio, with HVDC infrastructure sized to
scale from an initial 300MW rating toward 400MW as demand and generation ramp. Designed for >99.5%
uptime. Zero diesel dependency by design.

↻

### Autonomous Transit

Zero-emission robo-taxis, seaplanes, and smart port logistics. No private cars. Max 3-min wait.

ZERO-EMISSION MOBILITY

A fleet of autonomous electric robo-taxis - developed in partnership with Verne, Rimac's autonomous
division - serves as the island's primary covered transport, with maximum 3-minute wait times.
Pedestrian-first superblocks. Seaplane connections to Padang for mainland arrival.

↻

### ilipa One SEZ OS

Central nervous system. ERP, registry, capital gateway, and real-time ESG telemetry - sovereign
infrastructure.

Two Clouds | One Bridge
OPERATING LAYER

A "Two Clouds, One Bridge" architecture separates regulated and non-regulated workloads through an
auditable Glass Wall Bridge. Modules span ERP, the Revenue-Linked Application Gateway, the ACTA
corporate registry, MentEx market infrastructure, and real-time ESG telemetry for every operator in
the zone.

↻

### Agentic Concierge

AI digital steward for every resident and visitor. Logistics, governance, residency - in real time.
No data sold.

INTELLIGENT SERVICES

Not a chatbot. A digital steward woven into the ilipa One stack - available to every resident,
operator, and visitor from first contact. Handles logistics, residency, governance queries, and
operational intelligence in real time. Runs on sovereign infrastructure with no data sold to third
parties.

↻

### Digital Governance

Charter on-chain. English common law. Irrevocable.

COVENANT ARCHITECTURE

Modelled on the Delaware Court of Chancery and international financial centre courts in Hong Kong,
Dubai, and Astana. English common law applied inside the SEZ. Every operator and investor signs an
immutable covenant. The ACTA registry ensures all commitments are traceable, enforceable, and
irrevocable.

↻

### Blue Carbon Ledger

500k t CO2eTRACKED ON-CHAIN / YR
CARBON MARKETS

Targeting 500,000 tonnes of CO2e sequestration annually by 2036. The Ledger tracks, verifies, and
tokenises every tonne on-chain - routing revenue directly to the communities who protect the land.
Preservation engineered to fund itself.

↻

### Primate Index

6ENDEMIC SPECIES MONITORED
ENDEMIC SPECIES

Siberut is home to six endemic primates found nowhere else on Earth - including Kloss's Gibbon -
within a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve where 60% of the island remains tropical rainforest. The Primate
Index monitors populations in real time, feeding data into SEZ conservation covenant compliance.

↻

### Ocean Intelligence

500 kmCOASTLINE MONITORED
MARINE MONITORING

Five hundred kilometres of coastline. Among the most biodiverse reef systems in the Indo-Pacific.
The Ocean Intelligence platform monitors reef health, water chemistry, and biodiversity continuously
- data published openly and integrated into the SEZ's blue economy governance framework.

↻

### Smart Residency

DIGITAL | SOVEREIGN
CREATIVE COMMUNITY

Residency designed for makers, creators, and community builders - people who contribute to the
island's living culture, not just its economy. The ilipa One stack makes access to facilities,
programmes, and governance seamless from day one. Participation is the entry point. Belonging is the
outcome.

THE MILLION-YEAR MANDATE

> “We are not just building a city - we are guardians of a 10-million-year-old ecosystem.”

Our covenant binds every tenant, partner, and investor to measurable ecological outcomes - reviewed
every decade, irrevocable by design.

CONSERVATION COVENANT

## The *Living* Commitment

↻
Endemic Mammals
65%

of Siberut mammals found nowhere else on Earth

MAMMAL ENDEMISM

Siberut hosts the highest concentration of endemic mammals in the Mentawai archipelago - including
the pig-tailed langur, Mentawai macaque, and four gibbon species found nowhere else on Earth. The
SEZ covenant prohibits development within designated wildlife corridors.

↻
Endemic Flora
15%

of recorded plant species found only on Siberut

BOTANICAL RARITY

Approximately 15% of Siberut's recorded plant species are endemic - evolved entirely in place over
millions of years of island isolation. The SEZ mandates botanical survey and seed-banking programmes
before any ground is broken.

↻
Reptile & Amphibian Species
53

several still undescribed by science

HERPETOFAUNA

53 recorded reptile and amphibian species inhabit the island's rainforest and river systems -
several undescribed by science. The Primate Index monitoring network extends to herpetofauna,
feeding real-time population data into SEZ ecological compliance reporting.

↻
Bird Species
135

including Mentawai scops owl and hanging parrot

AVIAN DIVERSITY

135 bird species recorded on Siberut - including endemic species found nowhere else. The island sits
on a key Indo-Pacific migratory route. Dark-sky and acoustic buffer zones are written into the SEZ
land-use covenant.

↻
Forest Cover Target
48%→85%

by 2048, tracked via annual satellite analysis

REFORESTATION TARGET

Siberut's current forest cover stands at approximately 48% of its historical extent. The SEZ targets
85% by 2048 through active reforestation, corridor restoration, and an end to land-use conversion.
Progress published annually in the ESG telemetry feed.

↻
Marine Sanctuary Target
12%→65%

reef, seagrass and mangrove networks protected

MARINE PROTECTION

Only 12% of Mentawai's coastal waters are currently under formal marine protection. The SEZ targets
65% by 2048 - covering reef systems, seagrass beds, and mangrove networks. Marine sanctuary
boundaries are written into the SEZ operating licence and enforced through the Ocean Intelligence
platform.

↻
Intergenerational Mandate
100-Year

Legacy Trust

Every investor and operator signs a legally binding covenant reviewed every decade.

INTERGENERATIONAL MANDATE

Every operator, investor, and resident signs into a 100-year Legacy Trust - a legally binding
conservation covenant that cannot be dissolved by any single party. Ecological targets are reviewed
every decade by an independent panel. The land is not owned. It is stewarded.

↻
Public Health Goal

Eradication of Malaria

PUBLIC HEALTH

Malaria remains present in parts of Siberut. The SEZ health programme targets eradication through
vector control, clean-water infrastructure, and community health workers embedded in every district.
No development phase proceeds without a corresponding health infrastructure milestone.

↻
Protection Goal

Elimination of Illegal Logging

FOREST PROTECTION

The SEZ deploys satellite monitoring, community ranger networks, and economic alternatives -
replacing extraction income with covenant-backed conservation payments routed through the Blue
Carbon Ledger. Forest crime becomes economically irrational.

↻
Carbon Sequestration
500,000 t

CO2e per year by 2036, tracked on-chain

CARBON MARKETS

Forests and coastal ecosystems target 500,000 tonnes of CO2e sequestration annually by 2036. Every
tonne verified and tokenised via the Blue Carbon Ledger - revenue routed directly to communities who
protect the land.

↻
Endemic Primates
6

species monitored via Primate Index

ENDEMIC SPECIES

Six endemic primate species found nowhere else on Earth - including Kloss's Gibbon - within a UNESCO
Biosphere Reserve. The Primate Index monitors populations in real time, feeding data directly into
SEZ conservation covenant compliance reporting.

uptime. Zero diesel dependency by design.

↻

### Autonomous Transit

Zero-emission robo-taxis, seaplanes, and smart port logistics. No private cars. Max 3-min wait.

ZERO-EMISSION MOBILITY

A fleet of autonomous electric robo-taxis - developed in partnership with Verne, Rimac's autonomous
division - serves as the island's primary covered transport, with maximum 3-minute wait times.
Pedestrian-first superblocks. Seaplane connections to Padang for mainland arrival.

↻

### ilipa One SEZ OS

Central nervous system. ERP, registry, capital gateway, and real-time ESG telemetry - sovereign
infrastructure.

Two Clouds | One Bridge
OPERATING LAYER

A "Two Clouds, One Bridge" architecture separates regulated and non-regulated workloads through an
auditable Glass Wall Bridge. Modules span ERP, the Revenue-Linked Application Gateway, the ACTA
corporate registry, MentEx market infrastructure, and real-time ESG telemetry for every operator in
the zone.

↻

### Agentic Concierge

AI digital steward for every resident and visitor. Logistics, governance, residency - in real time.
No data sold.

INTELLIGENT SERVICES

Not a chatbot. A digital steward woven into the ilipa One stack - available to every resident,
operator, and visitor from first contact. Handles logistics, residency, governance queries, and
operational intelligence in real time. Runs on sovereign infrastructure with no data sold to third
parties.

↻

### Digital Governance

Charter on-chain. English common law. Irrevocable.

COVENANT ARCHITECTURE

Modelled on the Delaware Court of Chancery and international financial centre courts in Hong Kong,
Dubai, and Astana. English common law applied inside the SEZ. Every operator and investor signs an
immutable covenant. The ACTA registry ensures all commitments are traceable, enforceable, and
irrevocable.

↻

### Blue Carbon Ledger

500k t CO2eTRACKED ON-CHAIN / YR
CARBON MARKETS

Targeting 500,000 tonnes of CO2e sequestration annually by 2036. The Ledger tracks, verifies, and
tokenises every tonne on-chain - routing revenue directly to the communities who protect the land.
Preservation engineered to fund itself.

↻

### Primate Index

6ENDEMIC SPECIES MONITORED
ENDEMIC SPECIES

Siberut is home to six endemic primates found nowhere else on Earth - including Kloss's Gibbon -
within a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve where 60% of the island remains tropical rainforest. The Primate
Index monitors populations in real time, feeding data into SEZ conservation covenant compliance.

↻

### Ocean Intelligence

500 kmCOASTLINE MONITORED
MARINE MONITORING

Five hundred kilometres of coastline. Among the most biodiverse reef systems in the Indo-Pacific.
The Ocean Intelligence platform monitors reef health, water chemistry, and biodiversity continuously
- data published openly and integrated into the SEZ's blue economy governance framework.

↻

### Smart Residency

DIGITAL | SOVEREIGN
CREATIVE COMMUNITY

Residency designed for makers, creators, and community builders - people who contribute to the
island's living culture, not just its economy. The ilipa One stack makes access to facilities,
programmes, and governance seamless from day one. Participation is the entry point. Belonging is the
outcome.

THE MILLION-YEAR MANDATE

> “We are not just building a city - we are guardians of a 10-million-year-old ecosystem.”

Our covenant binds every tenant, partner, and investor to measurable ecological outcomes - reviewed
every decade, irrevocable by design.

CONSERVATION COVENANT

## The *Living* Commitment

↻
Endemic Mammals
65%

of Siberut mammals found nowhere else on Earth

MAMMAL ENDEMISM

Siberut hosts the highest concentration of endemic mammals in the Mentawai archipelago - including
the pig-tailed langur, Mentawai macaque, and four gibbon species found nowhere else on Earth. The
SEZ covenant prohibits development within designated wildlife corridors.

↻
Endemic Flora
15%

of recorded plant species found only on Siberut

BOTANICAL RARITY

Approximately 15% of Siberut's recorded plant species are endemic - evolved entirely in place over
millions of years of island isolation. The SEZ mandates botanical survey and seed-banking programmes
before any ground is broken.

↻
Reptile & Amphibian Species
53

several still undescribed by science

HERPETOFAUNA

53 recorded reptile and amphibian species inhabit the island's rainforest and river systems -
several undescribed by science. The Primate Index monitoring network extends to herpetofauna,
feeding real-time population data into SEZ ecological compliance reporting.

↻
Bird Species
135

including Mentawai scops owl and hanging parrot

AVIAN DIVERSITY

135 bird species recorded on Siberut - including endemic species found nowhere else. The island sits
on a key Indo-Pacific migratory route. Dark-sky and acoustic buffer zones are written into the SEZ
land-use covenant.

↻
Forest Cover Target
48%→85%

by 2048, tracked via annual satellite analysis

REFORESTATION TARGET

Siberut's current forest cover stands at approximately 48% of its historical extent. The SEZ targets
85% by 2048 through active reforestation, corridor restoration, and an end to land-use conversion.
Progress published annually in the ESG telemetry feed.

↻
Marine Sanctuary Target
12%→65%

reef, seagrass and mangrove networks protected

MARINE PROTECTION

Only 12% of Mentawai's coastal waters are currently under formal marine protection. The SEZ targets
65% by 2048 - covering reef systems, seagrass beds, and mangrove networks. Marine sanctuary
boundaries are written into the SEZ operating licence and enforced through the Ocean Intelligence
platform.

↻
Intergenerational Mandate
100-Year

Legacy Trust

Every investor and operator signs a legally binding covenant reviewed every decade.

INTERGENERATIONAL MANDATE

Every operator, investor, and resident signs into a 100-year Legacy Trust - a legally binding
conservation covenant that cannot be dissolved by any single party. Ecological targets are reviewed
every decade by an independent panel. The land is not owned. It is stewarded.

↻
Public Health Goal

Eradication of Malaria

PUBLIC HEALTH

Malaria remains present in parts of Siberut. The SEZ health programme targets eradication through
vector control, clean-water infrastructure, and community health workers embedded in every district.
No development phase proceeds without a corresponding health infrastructure milestone.

↻
Protection Goal

Elimination of Illegal Logging

FOREST PROTECTION

The SEZ deploys satellite monitoring, community ranger networks, and economic alternatives -
replacing extraction income with covenant-backed conservation payments routed through the Blue
Carbon Ledger. Forest crime becomes economically irrational.

↻

CO2e per year by 2036, tracked on-chain

CARBON MARKETS

Forests and coastal ecosystems target 500,000 tonnes of CO2e sequestration annually by 2036. Every
tonne verified and tokenised via the Blue Carbon Ledger - revenue routed directly to communities who
protect the land.

species monitored via Primate Index

## [Crew Exchange on International Seaplane Regatta MontAdria][96]

MontAdria provides pilot crew exchange where pilots can test any of this unique flying machines
during Regatta.

Experience rare models of seaplanes from all over the world in one place, no matter vintage or most
advanced, ULS category  commuter.
 

Video online streaming

During the Regatta flights will be displayed on a social and TV networks and video beams on the
sites.

## [Competition Update: Winner of the International Seaplane Regatta MontAdria Shines][97]

Our Regatta makes possible that we all feel victorious by enjoying of the unlimited freedom of
flying on the territory with  so diverse countryside. We share historical moments and making
together pioneering mission of reviving seaplane aviation exactly at the spot where it began.

 

Bonus pack

Demo race 1:

Seaplane vs Speadboat

Demo race 2:

Gyroplane vs Sportcar

## [Air Deck Solutions by MONTADRIA][98]

AERO 2025 Friedrichshafen
Developed through years of hands-on seaplane operations, Air Deck Solutions by MONTADRIA offer
modular, inflatable platforms designed for safe, efficient, and flexible docking in both coastal and
inland water environments.

Tested across Montenegro’s diverse terrain and showcased at AERO 2025, Air Deck Solutions are now
available globally for training, tourism, demo flights, and emergency operations.
 

Lightweight, durable, and easy to deploy, these platforms enhance accessibility for amphibious
aircraft — whether operating from yachts, remote lakes, or temporary water bases.

 

From water to air — made simple, safe, and smart.

## [Montenegro is a key partner in the development of the hydrodrome network][99]

Podgorica, July 2022
Montenegro has a great potential,  to be the key partner in the development of a unique network of
Sustainable Water Aerodromes and thus use the rich water resources in cooperation with Italy, Greece
and Albania and to develope it through Interreg IPA CBC. This was concluded at the meeting of
Italian delegation of Aviazione Marittima Italiana with Ministry of Economic Development and
Tourism with MontAdria as the main coordinator of the project in Montenegro.

## [Crew Exchange on International Seaplane Regatta MontAdria][96]

MontAdria provides pilot crew exchange where pilots can test any of this unique flying machines
during Regatta.

Experience rare models of seaplanes from all over the world in one place, no matter vintage or most
advanced, ULS category  commuter.
 

Video online streaming

During the Regatta flights will be displayed on a social and TV networks and video beams on the
sites.

## [Competition Update: Winner of the International Seaplane Regatta MontAdria Shines][97]

Our Regatta makes possible that we all feel victorious by enjoying of the unlimited freedom of
flying on the territory with  so diverse countryside. We share historical moments and making
together pioneering mission of reviving seaplane aviation exactly at the spot where it began.

Seaplane vs Speadboat

## [Air Deck Solutions by MONTADRIA][98]

AERO 2025 Friedrichshafen
Developed through years of hands-on seaplane operations, Air Deck Solutions by MONTADRIA offer
modular, inflatable platforms designed for safe, efficient, and flexible docking in both coastal and
inland water environments.

Tested across Montenegro’s diverse terrain and showcased at AERO 2025, Air Deck Solutions are now
available globally for training, tourism, demo flights, and emergency operations.
 

Lightweight, durable, and easy to deploy, these platforms enhance accessibility for amphibious
aircraft — whether operating from yachts, remote lakes, or temporary water bases.

 

From water to air — made simple, safe, and smart.

## [Montenegro is a key partner in the development of the hydrodrome network][99]

Podgorica, July 2022
Montenegro has a great potential,  to be the key partner in the development of a unique network of
Sustainable Water Aerodromes and thus use the rich water resources in cooperation with Italy, Greece
and Albania and to develope it through Interreg IPA CBC. This was concluded at the meeting of
Italian delegation of Aviazione Marittima Italiana with Ministry of Economic Development and
Tourism with MontAdria as the main coordinator of the project in Montenegro.

## Northwest Seaplanes
## 
## Family owned and operated since 1988

Northwest Seaplanes provides scheduled and charter seaplane flights to your favorite boating, BC
Salmon Fishing Lodges and Resorts and adventure destinations from South Lake Washington, in the
heart of Seattle to the San Juan Islands, Vancouver Island, and British Columbia’s Inside Passage.

With our fleet of five, six passenger Dehavilland Beavers to accommodate your transportation needs
for groups big and small. Our aircraft have access to hundreds of destinations throughout Western
Washington and British Columbia only accessible by seaplane.

Northwest Seaplanes offers both scheduled seaplane flights, exclusive seaplane charter flights and
Seattle Tours by seaplane to meet your every need! We are truly your best choice for Seattle
seaplane flights.

A family owned business with over 40 years of experience, Northwest Seaplanes is a trusted name in
the seaplanes, providing the finest quality seaplane service throughout the Pacific Northwest. Being
a smaller family owned business, we are able to provide a personalized customer service experience
that you just won’t experience anywhere else. Our business revolves around the personal
relationships we have made with our customers which have been a great part of our success.

*All flights are operated by Friday Harbor Seaplanes.*

news, and more.

company status.

## **Seaplane, an ancient flying machine
## with a bright future**

### The ideal instrument for developing tourism
### A new entry in the world of intermodal transportation

Seaplanes are **very versatile aircraft** that can operate in a wide variety of environments, from
the metropolitan areas to the extreme wilderness. Seaplanes allow operations unthinkable with any
other means of transport and open markets that would normally be unreachable for a normal aviation
business.

Seaplane can also play a role as **the first or last ring of intermodal transportation chains**.
They can take passengers between an intermediate stop or a hub and the very final destination, when
this is close to a water surface, whether it’s the centre of a town on a river, a tourist resort, a
lake, a place on the sea, an island.

In addition, seaplanes are **the safest type of aircraft**, as they can land on both water and land
with minimal damages even in an emergency, and in case of impact give to the occupants an
exceptional level of protection.

Seaplanes are also **the most environmental friendly flying machines**, as they do not need for
their operations infrastructures different from natural water, making no use of land.
In addition, seaplane do not need an exclusive use of water surfaces and normally share them with a
variety of users.

Last but not least, seaplanes are among **the less expensive tool for flying**, considering the
versatile service given.

This machines, born with aviation itself, are **prototypes of the utility aircraft**, the means of
transport **associated with adventure** , beloved toys for the wealthiest, but also effective 
instruments to offer valuable services to remote communities and bring help and hope to the poorest.

Far from being a remnant of the earliest times of flying, seaplanes can be **a powerful instrument
for developing aviation and tourism**.

The goal of the **Seaplane Team** is to offer a comprehensive consultancy service on the setting up
of seaplane operations, seaplane bases and flight schools for seaplane pilots.

## **Seaplane, an ancient flying machine
## with a bright future**

### The ideal instrument for developing tourism
### A new entry in the world of intermodal transportation

Seaplanes are **very versatile aircraft** that can operate in a wide variety of environments, from
the metropolitan areas to the extreme wilderness. Seaplanes allow operations unthinkable with any
other means of transport and open markets that would normally be unreachable for a normal aviation
business.

Seaplane can also play a role as **the first or last ring of intermodal transportation chains**.
They can take passengers between an intermediate stop or a hub and the very final destination, when
this is close to a water surface, whether it’s the centre of a town on a river, a tourist resort, a
lake, a place on the sea, an island.

In addition, seaplanes are **the safest type of aircraft**, as they can land on both water and land
with minimal damages even in an emergency, and in case of impact give to the occupants an
exceptional level of protection.

Seaplanes are also **the most environmental friendly flying machines**, as they do not need for
their operations infrastructures different from natural water, making no use of land.
In addition, seaplane do not need an exclusive use of water surfaces and normally share them with a
variety of users.

Last but not least, seaplanes are among **the less expensive tool for flying**, considering the
versatile service given.

This machines, born with aviation itself, are **prototypes of the utility aircraft**, the means of
transport **associated with adventure** , beloved toys for the wealthiest, but also effective 
instruments to offer valuable services to remote communities and bring help and hope to the poorest.

Far from being a remnant of the earliest times of flying, seaplanes can be **a powerful instrument
for developing aviation and tourism**.

The goal of the **Seaplane Team** is to offer a comprehensive consultancy service on the setting up
of seaplane operations, seaplane bases and flight schools for seaplane pilots.

SeatMaps is a company founded by Fred Finn, a Guinness World Record holder for passenger miles, and
Djois Franklin, a tech veteran from AMD and Microsoft. Based in London and Munich, we combine Fred's
experience with the weekly updated seat map data for over 700 airlines. Our 360° panoramic
technology helps to get an immersive view of any cabin from (A) Airbus to (Z) Zlin Aircraft. Read
flight reviews of others and rate your own experience. Use SeatMaps to find the most comfortable
seat for your next flight!
Now, take your passion for aviation even further with Fred's newly published book, "Sonic Boom",
which details his 718 flights on the iconic Concorde. Dive into thrilling stories, insider tips, and

So you wanna get into fish games, huh? Well, you’ve come to the right place. Fish games are HUGE in
Malaysia, like seriously, everyone’s playing them. And I mean *everyone*. We’re talking your
grandma, your little cousin, the guy who delivers your nasi lemak. Okay, maybe not *literally*
everyone, but you get the point. They’re popular! What are fish games exactly? Basically, any
digital game that revolves around fish and ocean themes. Seems simple, right? But in Malaysia, it
breaks down into a few key types:
* Fish shooting (or “tembak ikan” if you’re feeling local)
* Fishing simulators (“game mancing”)
* Casual fish games, like puzzles

Fish shooting is by far the most popular. I mean, who doesn’t love blasting fish with virtual
cannons and racking up points? It’s like a digital arcade, but with more scales. The concept is easy
to grasp, the visuals are usually top-notch, and the chance to win real money is always dangling
there like a delicious worm. Now, Southeast Asia makes up a whopping 40% of all fish game players
worldwide! Malaysia, of course, is in the top five. This isn’t just some small trend; it’s a
full-blown phenomenon! Analysts predict the fishing games market will be worth over USD 2 billion by
2026. Let’s talk about those games a bit more. If you are more of the outdoorsy type, you might want
to try one of the “game mancing” fishing simulator games. These put you in the shoes of a digital
angler. It’s more about patience and strategy than frantic shooting, and can be very relaxing. Think
of it as digital [https://fishing-game.my/][31] angling, but without the sunburn and mosquitoes.
Want to unwind after a long day at work? These are for you! There are even casual fish puzzle games
out there for people looking for something less intense! But here’s a tip: Watch out for shady
platforms. There are always a few bad apples in every digital sea. Always do your research before
diving in and handing over your hard-earned ringgit. Make sure the platform is licensed and has a
good reputation. Don’t just jump in because you saw a flashy ad online. Seriously, do people even
read these blog posts? I sure hope so! Because I put a lot of effort into them. Anyway, have fun and

Turtle Airways FAQ's

#### Why Turtle Airways?
* Fiji’s safest and longest serving seaplane operator, a clean safety record for the last 30 years
  of operation.
* We offer flights every other hour, allowing for convenient connections and ‘same-day’ transfers to
  your Island resort.
* Get to your island resort faster. Transfers are 15-33 mins to the Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands
* Guaranteed the lowest prices in Island resort transfers by air.
* Turtle Airways is a great alternative to a long boat ride in rough waters

#### How do I book a seaplane transfer?

Simply fill out our inquiry form below ensuring to include a few of your travel details, and we’ll
assist you in making your reservation. Alternatively, you can reach us on the following phone
number; + 679 6721 888 (9:00 am – 5:00 pm Fiji Standard time).

#### How long does it take to fly to the islands?

– It takes approximately 15 minutes to the Mamanuca Islands, and 33 minutes to the Yasawa Islands

#### Where is Turtle Airways seaplane base located?

– Turtle Airways is located on Wailoaloa Beach, New Town. This is on the beach right next to the
Nadi International Airport. This is marked on the Google map provided below. You will need to go
around the airport to get to our seaplane base, and is a 15-20 minute drive from the Nadi Airport
terminal.

#### How do I get to the Turtle Airways seaplane base?

– Check with your resort to see if they offer Airport transfers to our seaplane base. Alternatively,
you can catch a taxi for a small fee. If coming from the Nadi Airport you will find ‘yellow’ taxis
located outside the terminal. It costs approximately AU$9-14 and takes between 15-20 minutes. If
coming to us from a hotel, please inquire at reception about getting a taxi, or for other transfer
options.

#### How many people can fly on a seaplane at any one time?

– Our seaplanes can carry up to 6 passengers, and can carry 460 kg (combined weight) for flights
departing Nadi, and 480 kg (combined weight) for flights to Nadi.

#### Is there a minimum number of passengers?

– Minimum of two passengers per booking. However, single passenger bookings can be accepted on a
space available basis.

#### What is the baggage allowance?

– Please contact us regarding this as it does vary depending on size and weight

#### Am I able to book a seaplane transfer from one Island to another?

– Yes we offer inter island transfers. Please contact us for more information.

Turtle Airways FAQ's

#### Why Turtle Airways?
* Fiji’s safest and longest serving seaplane operator, a clean safety record for the last 30 years
  of operation.
* We offer flights every other hour, allowing for convenient connections and ‘same-day’ transfers to
  your Island resort.
* Get to your island resort faster. Transfers are 15-33 mins to the Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands
* Guaranteed the lowest prices in Island resort transfers by air.
* Turtle Airways is a great alternative to a long boat ride in rough waters

#### How do I book a seaplane transfer?

Simply fill out our inquiry form below ensuring to include a few of your travel details, and we’ll
assist you in making your reservation. Alternatively, you can reach us on the following phone
number; + 679 6721 888 (9:00 am – 5:00 pm Fiji Standard time).

#### How long does it take to fly to the islands?

– It takes approximately 15 minutes to the Mamanuca Islands, and 33 minutes to the Yasawa Islands

#### Where is Turtle Airways seaplane base located?

– Turtle Airways is located on Wailoaloa Beach, New Town. This is on the beach right next to the
Nadi International Airport. This is marked on the Google map provided below. You will need to go
around the airport to get to our seaplane base, and is a 15-20 minute drive from the Nadi Airport
terminal.

#### How do I get to the Turtle Airways seaplane base?

– Check with your resort to see if they offer Airport transfers to our seaplane base. Alternatively,
you can catch a taxi for a small fee. If coming from the Nadi Airport you will find ‘yellow’ taxis
located outside the terminal. It costs approximately AU$9-14 and takes between 15-20 minutes. If
coming to us from a hotel, please inquire at reception about getting a taxi, or for other transfer
options.

#### How many people can fly on a seaplane at any one time?

– Our seaplanes can carry up to 6 passengers, and can carry 460 kg (combined weight) for flights
departing Nadi, and 480 kg (combined weight) for flights to Nadi.

#### Is there a minimum number of passengers?

– Minimum of two passengers per booking. However, single passenger bookings can be accepted on a
space available basis.

#### What is the baggage allowance?

– Please contact us regarding this as it does vary depending on size and weight

#### Am I able to book a seaplane transfer from one Island to another?

– Yes we offer inter island transfers. Please contact us for more information.

## See the Full Ownership Picture

Every product on store shelves has a story of ownership behind it. Major corporations often control
dozens of seemingly independent brands across multiple industries, making it difficult to know where
your money actually goes. Who Brands cuts through this complexity by mapping corporate ownership
structures in a clear, accessible format. Whether you want to support independent businesses,
research conglomerate portfolios, compare brand origins by country, or simply learn about the
companies producing your favorite products, our comprehensive database gives you the transparency
needed to navigate today's corporate landscape with confidence.

1380+ Brands
Verified Data

## Research-Backed and Regularly Updated

Accuracy matters when it comes to corporate ownership data. Our editorial team tracks corporate
filings, press releases, merger announcements, and public records to maintain reliable and current
information. Each brand profile includes founding details, acquisition timelines, parent company
profiles, headquarters locations, and manufacturing countries sourced from official disclosures. We
update our records regularly to reflect the latest mergers, acquisitions, and corporate
restructurings happening around the world. This commitment to accuracy, transparency, and editorial
thoroughness is what makes Who Brands a trusted resource for consumers, researchers, and journalists
seeking verified ownership information.

## Make Informed Consumer Choices

Knowing who owns a brand helps you align your spending with your values. Some consumers prefer to
support locally headquartered companies, while others look for brands backed by organizations with
strong sustainability commitments or proven industry expertise. Our ownership data, combined with
detailed industry categorization, tag-based filtering, and headquarters location information, makes
it straightforward to explore brands by country, category, or parent company. Use our search tools
and filters to find brands that match what matters most to you, compare corporate portfolios side by
side, and take meaningful control of your purchasing decisions.
